# proxmox_ha_rules (Data Source)

Lists the high-availability placement rules of the cluster from `/cluster/ha/rules`, sorted by rule name. `errors` carries the per-rule validation messages the HA manager reports.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_ha_rules" "node_affinity" {
  type = "node-affinity"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `type` (String) Restrict the result to `node-affinity` or `resource-affinity`. An empty value disables this filter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this data source call.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Matching rules, sorted by `rule`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `affinity` (String)
- `comment` (String)
- `disable` (Boolean)
- `errors` (Map of String)
- `nodes` (Map of Number)
- `resources` (List of String)
- `rule` (String)
- `strict` (Boolean)
- `type` (String)
